biggest_catch: Missions pay 'various amounts' — official terms give a $1/minute average, not a per-mission guarantee, and you must apply and be selected for each mission; the catalog's '$75' is plausible per mission but not promised.
catches: Official dscout.com participate page: 'projects paying various amounts depending on their specific requirements and time allocated' — no guaranteed per-mission figure.
Official stat is '$1 average dollars earned per minute' — an average, not a minimum; short missions pay less.
You must apply to each mission and be selected; application does not guarantee a spot.
Payment comes via PayPal; no minimum payout threshold.
Third-party reports put typical missions at $25–$150 (up to $200 for diary/live missions) — official terms only confirm the average rate.
Money can be withheld if responses are low-effort or fail review.

steps: Sign up as a scout at https://dscout.com/participate-in-research-studies (or download the dscout app).
Complete your profile so you can be matched to missions.
Browse open missions and apply to ones that fit — most require a short application/video aptitude check.
Review the detailed preview: tasks, time estimate, and compensation shown before you commit.
Complete the mission (diary entries, video responses, photos) to a high standard — low-effort responses can be rejected.
Get paid via PayPal after the mission is reviewed and approved.
